Dear Mr. Humam,

For the extension, we normally follow up 7 days prior to the check-out date.

Please note that if the payment for the first and last month had been made, we would have been able to block the unit for 6 months in advance and provide the relevant documents accordingly.

However, as you have preferred a monthly arrangement, we will be updating and confirming the extension on a month-to-month basis.

Thank you for your understanding.
